license_required.quote: Any person who practices medicine, osteopathy, or any of the branches thereof without a license, certificate, or permit issued by the board is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

issuing_authority.value: Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: Any person desiring to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy, surgery, or obstetrics in any of their branches in this state shall apply to the Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners for a license.

name.value: Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners
name.quote: shall apply to the Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners for a license

type.quote: Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners

age_minimum.quote: The Board of Examiners shall grant a license to any applicant who gives satisfactory proof of being at least eighteen years of age

moral_character_required.quote: who gives satisfactory proof of being at least eighteen years of age and who is of good moral character

degree_required.value: Diploma from an approved medical or osteopathic college
degree_required.quote: presents evidence of having graduated and received a diploma from a medical or osteopathic college approved by the board

accrediting_body.value: Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners
accrediting_body.quote: a medical or osteopathic college approved by the board in accordance with rules adopted pursuant to chapter 1-26

required.quote: The applicant shall also present evidence satisfactory to the board of successful completion of a program as an intern or resident, or of equivalent service approved by the board, in a hospital approved by the board

duration.quote: for such time as the board requires by rule adopted pursuant to chapter 1-26

kind.quote: successful completion of a program as an intern or resident, or of equivalent service approved by the board

exams.name: Written examination (USMLE or equivalent)
exams.notes: Minimum 75% correct answers required; must pass all parts within 7 years (10 years for MD-PhD); board-certified by ABMS may waive 7-year requirement
exams.quote: The examination required by this chapter shall be in writing. Each applicant shall be required to attain an average percentage of at least seventy-five percent of correct answers.

interval_years.quote: The renewal shall be issued by the secretary upon payment of a biennial fee set by the board

required.quote: Physicians shall comply with all continuing professional development or continuing medical education requirements for renewal of a license issued by a member state.

available.quote: The Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners may, without examination, issue a license to any applicant holding a currently valid license or certificate issued to the applicant by the examining board of the District of Columbia, any state or territory of the United States, the National Board of Medical Examiners, the National Board of Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons, or any province of Canada

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a currently valid license from another jurisdiction with requirements not less than those of South Dakota at the time the license was issued; board may require oral or written examination and personal appearance.
requirements.quote: if the legal requirements of the examining board at the time it issued the license or certificate were not less than those of this state at the time the license is presented for registration

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who practices medicine, osteopathy, or any of the branches thereof without a license, certificate, or permit issued by the board is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

credential_type.quote: the Board of Examiners shall grant a license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine, surgery, and obstetrics in all of their branches, without limitations, in this state

is_mandatory.quote: No person required to be licensed, certificated, or permitted under the provisions of this chapter shall practice the person's profession in the State of South Dakota without such active license, certificate, or permit

title_protection.quote: to append or prefix the letters M.D., or D. O. or the title of Doctor or Dr. or Specialist or Osteopath or any other sign or appellation in a medical sense to one's name or to profess publicly to be a physician or surgeon

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices medicine, osteopathy, or any of the branches thereof without a license, certificate, or permit issued by the board is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Producing or aiding or abetting a criminal abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Producing or aiding or abetting a criminal abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing what is known as cappers or steerers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing what is known as cappers or steerers

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a fee on the assurance that a manifestly incurable disease can be permanently cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee on the assurance that a manifestly incurable disease can be permanently cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully betraying a professional confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully betraying a professional confidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising medical business with untruthful or misleading statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All advertising of medical business in which untruthful or improbable statements are made or which are calculated to mislead or deceive the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, criminal offense arising from practice of medicine, or offense involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any criminal offense of the grade of felony, any conviction of a criminal offense arising out of the practice of medicine or osteopathy, or one in connection with any criminal offense involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habits of intemperance or drug addiction affecting the licensee's practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habits of intemperance or drug addiction, calculated in the opinion of the Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners to affect the licensee's practice of the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal or neglect to report a diseased or unsanitary condition to health authorities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusal or neglect to report the existence of a diseased or unsanitary condition to the proper health authorities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing intoxicants, narcotics, or habit-forming drugs in quantities or circumstances not for legitimate medicinal purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing intoxicants, narcotics, barbiturates, or other habit-forming drugs to any person in quantities and under circumstances making it apparent to the board that the prescription was not made for legitimate medicinal purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Splitting fees or giving consideration for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Splitting fees or giving to any person furnishing a patient any portion of the fees received from the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to disclose one's school of practice or professional academic degree when using a professional title
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to disclose one's school of practice or one's professional academic degree when using a professional title or designation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sustaining a physical or mental disability rendering further practice dangerous
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sustaining any physical or mental disability which renders the further practice of a licensee's profession dangerous

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with state or federal laws on keeping records regarding narcotics and habit-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with state or federal laws on keeping records regarding possessing and dispensing of narcotics, barbiturates, and habit-forming drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying medical records of a patient or official records regarding narcotics or medical treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsifying the medical records of a patient or any official record regarding possession and dispensing of narcotics, barbiturates, and habit-forming drugs or regarding any phase of medical treatment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting a license, certificate, or diploma obtained by fraud or deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presenting to the board any license, certificate, or diploma which was obtained by fraud or deception practiced in passing a required examination or which was obtained by the giving of false statements or information on applying for the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Illegally or fraudulently obtaining a license through deception or false statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Illegally, fraudulently, or wrongfully obtaining a license required by this chapter by the use of any means, devices, deceptions, or helps in passing any examination or by making false statements or misrepresentations in any applications or information presented

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violating §34-23A-10.1
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of violating §34-23A-10.1

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing medical services declared by the board to be of no medical value
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing medical services which have been declared, by declaratory ruling of the board, to be of no medical value

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence within the physician-patient relationship to engage a patient in sexual activity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The exercise of influence within the physician-patient relationship for the purposes of engaging a patient in sexual activity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in gross or immoral sexual harassment or sexual contact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in gross or immoral sexual harassment or sexual contact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Consistently providing or prescribing medical services or treatments that are inappropriate or unnecessary
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Consistently providing or prescribing medical services or treatments which are inappropriate or unnecessary

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any practice or conduct constituting a danger to public health or unbecoming a licensed physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any practice or conduct which tends to constitute a danger to the health, welfare, or safety of the public or patients or engaging in conduct which is unbecoming a person licensed to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to fulfill a valid obligation to a federal or state student loan or scholarship program for medical school education
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to fulfill a valid obligation to a federal or state student loan or scholarship program for medical school education designed to provide medical services to underserved geographical areas

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another state, territorial, or provincial licensing board or the District of Columbia
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another state, territorial, or provincial licensing board or the licensing board of the District of Columbia.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetence, defined as deviation from the statewide standard of competence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: professional incompetence is a deviation from the statewide standard of competence, which is that minimum degree of skill and knowledge necessary for the performance of characteristic tasks of a physician or surgeon in at least a reasonably effective way

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Any nonresident physician who provides diagnostic or treatment services through electronic means to a patient located in South Dakota is engaged in the practice of medicine in this state and must be licensed accordingly.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Any nonresident physician or osteopath who, while located outside this state, provides diagnostic or treatment services through electronic means to a patient located in this state ... is engaged in the practice of medicine or osteopathy in this state.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Any nonresident physician or osteopath who, while located outside this state, provides diagnostic or treatment services through electronic means to a patient located in this state ... is engaged in the practice of medicine or osteopathy in this state.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join the compact

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Any person licensed under chapter 36-4 shall report to the board, within thirty days of the date of the action, any of the acts included in §36-4-30 and any of the following: ... Judgments or settlements related to malpractice.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Every facility licensed by the state where medicine is practiced which suspends or revokes the privilege of a licensee of the Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners to practice medicine therein for incompetence or unprofessional conduct as defined in this chapter shall report it in writing to the board

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: In case any person holding a license, resident license, or certificate to practice allopathic or osteopathic medicine, surgery and obstetrics shall by any final order or adjudication of any court of competent jurisdiction be adjudged to be mentally incompetent or insane, the license, resident license, or certificate shall be suspended by the board

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A locum tenens certificate is a certificate allowing the holder thereof to practice medicine in this state for a limited period of time and subject to the requirements and conditions set forth in said certificate.
